geometry_notes: The sections are SOLID trapezoids: the oval loops and rectangles in the drawings are stirrups/connector reinforcement (dashed = projecting bars), not voids. The research lead's 'voided beam' description is wrong; mass per metre confirms a solid section.
Top: central 51 cm at full height; 4 cm wide ledges 2 cm lower at each edge (joint/grout key), riser inclined 0.5 cm (dims 4.5 = 4 + 0.5).

Sides: straight line from the ledge edge (x = 30, y = H - 2) to the theoretical soffit corner (x = 30 - inset, y = 0); insets 4/6/8 give 1:5, 1:5 and 1:4.75 (SHP-40 printed 8 over 38; text says 1:5 nominally) - printed insets used.
Soffit corner: tangent round with 1.5 cm tangent lengths (dims 1.5 horizontal on the soffit, 0.3 + 1.5 vertical on the side) - transcribed-with-convention (circular arc assumed).
Top outer corner: small round with 1 cm tangent lengths (dims '1' horizontal and '1' in the vertical chain) drawn as a tiny circle; implemented as a tangent round (convention).
Shear connectors / projecting reinforcement above the top are not part of the concrete section.
The top-edge round makes the extreme width 596.4 mm; the printed 60 cm is to the theoretical sharp corner (as the 52/48/44 soffit dims are to the theoretical bottom corner).
